varieties.name: Vittatum
varieties.note: The common one: a cream stripe down the middle of each leaf, green margins.

varieties.name: Variegatum
varieties.note: The reverse: green centre, cream margins. A little slower than Vittatum.

varieties.name: Bonnie
varieties.note: Curled leaves on a compact plant. The same stripe as Vittatum, in less room.

varieties.name: Ocean
varieties.note: Short, broad leaves with cream margins. Stays small and clumping.

varieties.name: Hawaiian
varieties.note: New leaves come up champagne-toned and mature to green. Needs good light to show it.

varieties.name: Plain green
varieties.note: No variegation. The toughest of them, and the least fussy about light.

watering.label: Water once the top of the pot dries; the roots carry a reserve

drainage.label: Free-draining mix; the tuberous roots fill the pot and hold water themselves
